Historical reconstruction preview for Microsoft (MSFT), calendar Q3 2026 (Microsoft FY2027 Q1). This preview was reconstructed from the FY2026 Q4 press release issued on July 29, 2026. It was not written before the target quarter earnings release.

Basis: In Q4 FY26 (calendar Q2 2026), revenue was $90.0 billion, up 18% (up 17% in constant currency). Operating income was $40.6 billion, up 18%. GAAP diluted EPS was $4.81, up 32%. Non-GAAP diluted EPS was $4.74, up 23%. Microsoft Cloud revenue was $59.3 billion, up 27%. Azure and other cloud services revenue was up 43%. Commercial remaining performance obligation was $678 billion, up 84%. Productivity and Business Processes revenue was $37.8 billion, up 14%. Intelligent Cloud revenue was $39.3 billion, up 32%. More Personal Computing revenue was $12.9 billion, down 4%. Xbox content and services revenue was down 10%. Windows OEM and Devices revenue was down 7%. GAAP net income included a $480 million net gain from investments in OpenAI; non-GAAP results exclude this impact. One-time items, including a $3.2 billion gain from Anthropic, had a net benefit of $0.27 to diluted EPS. The company said the quarter exceeded guidance on revenue, operating income, and diluted EPS after adjusting for these items.

Guidance: The press release says forward-looking guidance was provided on the earnings call. The release text does not include the guidance numbers. Therefore, this preview does not cite a guidance range.

Core questions: 1. Can Azure continue to grow at a high rate? 2. How quickly will the large commercial backlog convert to revenue? 3. Will PC and gaming weakness continue?

Positive factors: Azure and Microsoft Cloud growth, high cRPO, Azure annual revenue above $100 billion, and Microsoft 365 Copilot paid seats above 30 million. Negative factors: AI investment fair-value adjustments, PC/gaming weakness, high comparison base, and currency effects.

Verification points: Compare revenue, operating income, and non-GAAP EPS growth with Q4 FY26 rates. Check Azure growth. Check Microsoft Cloud and cRPO growth. Check Xbox and Windows OEM/Devices. Check OpenAI adjustment and one-time items.
reader_questions: 如果7月29日电话会议给出的FY2027Q1指引与上季动能方向相反，本稿基准如何修正？新闻稿正文未披露指引数字，需要电话会议记录才能核实。
Anthropic的32亿美元收益是一次性项目，还是AI投资公允价值会持续造成GAAP EPS波动？若未来季度再次出现大额未实现损益，GAAP与非GAAP EPS的可比性会改变。
Azure的43%增长是否包含多年期合同或AI合同的前置确认？如果增长主要来自积压确认而非新增用量，cRPO转化速度的结论需要重估。
